reviews.review_title: Good but needs more maps and higher fps
reviews.review_description: This game is interesting and has some good parts but the   fps throws me off as it runs at 25 fps making a laggy experience and it needs more maps/modes and player tracking on the monsters. But this game is promising but needs improvements  has potential

developer_response.body: Thank you for your review. The FPS issue is being investigated, and we are working on a fix. The Horror Monsters do have Following, however the range is small. In update 8, the horror monsters have been fixed, and we are working on adding more maps/gamemodes. If you have Discord, please join our discord server at https://discord.gg/ASvhbpmK9U and give use some suggestions. We are out of map/gamemode ideas. Thanks. -Xavii
